_note: Ids are the ones the established counter (BrainRot 21.0.632) relies on, read from its shipped APK. They are entry names; package names are prefixed at lookup. Geometry and the edge action column are the fallbacks if Instagram renames them.
reel_recycler is the Shorts pager. The comments and description panels pause counting. reel_player_page_content holds the channel handle and title for the reel on screen.

view_rootview is each video page. title/desc are the author and caption. wbs/go5 (musically) and s4q/fb6 (trill) are obfuscated ids that change between TikTok builds; when they stop matching, the whole-page fingerprint takes over.

Facebook exposes no stable ids for Reels. Detection is the strict edge action column (EdgeColumn): counted like/comment/share labels stacked at the edge, at least two different actions, over a full-width described media node. The pager-shape fallback is off because the News Feed looks like a pager whenever one tall post fills the screen. Approach informed by studying BrainPal (com.brainrot.android); thresholds are our own.
spotlight_container is the Spotlight feed. Snapchat obfuscates most other ids, so identity falls back to the visible page.
